questions.prompt: Which of these are chess pieces?
questions.fact: The knight is the only piece that can jump over others.

questions.prompt: Which of these are units of energy?
questions.fact: A watt is a joule every second, so a kilowatt-hour is 3.6 million joules.

questions.prompt: How long is the River Thames, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 346 km, from the Cotswolds to the North Sea.

questions.prompt: How many litres of maple sap does it take to make one litre of maple syrup?
questions.fact: About 40. The sap is mostly water, and it is boiled for hours to thicken it.

questions.prompt: Who came up with evolution by natural selection?
questions.hint: He sailed round the world on HMS Beagle.
questions.fact: Charles Darwin waited more than twenty years before publishing On the Origin of Species in 1859.

questions.prompt: Which Roman god matches the Greek god of war, Ares?
questions.hint: The red planet is named after him.
questions.fact: The month of March is named after Mars, because it was when the Roman army set out to fight.
